claim_text: Lordstown has approximately 100,000 pre-orders for the Endurance pickup truck
f_M_query: Verify named customers exist as fleet operators in FMCSA SAFER database with fleet sizes consistent with claimed orders. Specifically test the named large customers (E-Squared Energy Advisors 14,000 trucks; Hotwire Communications 1,000 trucks; Hot Lync ~1,000) — are these real fleet operators?

claim_text: Lordstown's Endurance is a production-ready vehicle scheduled for delivery in late 2021
f_M_query: NHTSA manufacturer registration with VIN issuance authority; EPA emissions test certification; CARB executive order; OSHA establishment data for production-ramp employment counts at Lordstown OH facility

claim_text: Lordstown owns and operates the former GM Lordstown Assembly plant (6.2M sq ft) for production
f_M_query: GM (CIK 0001467858) SEC filings disclosing the 2019 Lordstown plant transfer; Mahoning County OH property records; satellite imagery of facility activity 2019-2021

claim_text: Lordstown has proprietary in-wheel hub motor technology that enables the Endurance
f_M_query: Google Patents assignee search for 'Lordstown Motors' and 'Workhorse Group' (predecessor licensor) for in-wheel hub motor patents pre-cutoff. Categorize titles for hub motor / in-wheel motor / drive system.

claim_text: Lordstown has commercial fleet customer commitments from named operators (E-Squared, Hotwire, Hot Lync)
f_M_query: FMCSA SAFER for E-Squared Energy Advisors and Hotwire Communications — are they registered as motor carriers? What's their actual fleet size? An ISP (Hotwire) ordering 1,000 trucks is suspicious if they have no commercial vehicle fleet.

claim_text: Lordstown received a $40M secured loan from GM as part of strategic partnership; GM committed to provide certain components
f_M_query: GM SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q) for 2019-2020 discussing the Lordstown plant sale and any committed component supply or technology transfer; USPTO joint Lordstown-GM patent assignments

claim_text: Steve Burns and other insiders are aligned with shareholders (implied by S-4 / lock-up disclosures)
f_M_query: Form 4 filings on EDGAR for Lordstown insiders (Steve Burns CEO, others) showing buy/sell timing relative to public statements. Specifically test if insider selling preceded any negative information.

claim_text: Lordstown's pre-orders represent serious customer commitments for the Endurance program
f_M_query: DEFM14A self-text analysis: count of 'binding' vs 'non-binding' vs 'letter of intent'/'LOI' mentions in pre-order/reservation context
